answer.reason: The value 249,530,741 MWh is consistent with an overall total net generation figure, while the IPP & CHP category in the Florida electricity profile is a much smaller subtotal, matching 16,588,495 MWh.

B. 249,530,741 megawatthours

Source citation: Florida Electricity Profile 2024 (https://www.eia.gov/electricity/state/florida/index.php)
